name: citizen-of-nowhere-data
title: Citizen of Nowhere open data: Elo ratings and rankings
description: Free, daily-refreshed Elo ratings and rankings computed by Citizen of Nowhere (rankings.citizenofnowhere.org): NFL, college football, NBA, NHL, MLB, WNBA, AFL, NRL, IPL and world football Elo, the Universal Index, the Global Metro Power Rankings and other site-own rankings.

resources.name: nfl-elo
resources.title: NFL Elo ratings: current ratings
resources.description: NFL Elo ratings is Citizen of Nowhere Elo rating of every NFL franchise since 1920, updated after each week's games (K 20, home advantage 65; method at https://rankings.citizenofnowhere.org/methodology/elo; historical series from Neil Paine's published game logs), a free, maintained alternative to FiveThirtyEight's discontinued NFL Elo. As of 2026-11-26. Page: https://rankings.citizenofnowhere.org/teams/nfl
